evening.caption:
Sky brushed away the soil and found a hidden jewel, and when the sunlight passed through it, she became one too ✨

Sky is the gentle Yin spirit, and when she held the crystal she became Yin Metal: the jewel. Xin Metal isn't the heavy sword or the iron gate. It is refined, precise and quietly brilliant, beauty polished by pressure that shines most when light is let in. In people, it is the side that notices the finest details, keeps high standards, chooses words with care and has a sparkle others only see up close. Small, but precious.

Who is the hidden jewel in your life, the one whose shine you noticed up close? Tag them below 👇
